stage1.impression: A long, deep, dark bar seen through a shopfront with a good layered plan (shelves, plinth, island, bar, a lit box at the end), but it reads as a CG walkthrough: the people are smeared grey ghosts, the band under the ceiling is a flat khaki strip rather than glowing acrylic, a third of the frame on the right is a dead dark plane, and the brightest, most saturated thing is a floating RGB ring sculpture plus a scatter of candy-coloured spheres. As it stands a magazine would see a generic moody bar render, not a specific, well-made place; the lantern idea is there but does not stop a passer-by.

blocking_9: Frame lum_median between 22 and 35 with the shadows holding detail (now 15.7)
The lantern's amber band reads as glowing amber acrylic fins with visible fin rhythm and lit edges, not a flat beige panel (delta_e to #E0962E <= 6, now 15.5)
People read as real patrons softly blurred, not translucent grey ghosts
No dead third: the right-hand pier/return (x 950-1200) either cropped out or carrying detail (lum_median >= 18)
Evidence of the shopfront glass: a faint, believable street reflection over the dark areas
The lantern is the clear hero and the visual end of the room; the RGB rings must not out-shout it
Material detail at 1:1: oak grain, terrazzo chips at real scale, plaster texture on the right wall; no grain/noise in flat dark areas
Some sign of life near camera (a glass, a record out, a coat on the island)

defects.what: Frame too dark overall: lum_median 15.7, 77% of pixels below 40
Amber acrylic band reads as a flat, opaque khaki panel with a faint stripe; no glow, no lit fin edges, no bloom onto the ceiling (RGB 161/118/63, falloff flat 115-131)
Large dead dark plane (pier/return) occupying a fifth of the frame, lum_median 8.4, with a muddy brown gradient and visible noise
Eight figures with shutter 1.0 smear into translucent grey ghosts; read as CG artefacts, not people
Mother EARF reads as a floating multicolour neon ring gizmo; the most saturated, distracting element in the frame, competing with the lantern
Ceiling crushed (median 5.3, crush 26.8%); downlights are bare dots that light nothing visible
Front of the island/table body almost black (median 4.6); reads as a void
Dark vertical mullion at full height splits the left third without any glass or frame detail
Terrazzo plinth is the brightest large area (median 80) and pulls the eye from the lantern; chip texture blotchy and noisy at 1:1
Shelves mostly empty with bright LED strip lines; reads as a showroom fixture
Pendants in purple/white/salmon add more competing colour
Ceiling-to-wall edge on the right is a soft featureless gradient; no geometry readable

changes.problem: The lantern's amber band, the hero of this frame, does not glow; it reads as a flat beige panel.

evidence.measured: lum_median 122, RGB 161/118/63, delta_e2000 15.5 to #E0962E, profile flat 115-131 across x

change.setting: the lantern's band emission (behind the Smoke fins), and its colour
change.to: 0.45, 2000 K amber, with the foot line kept at 9.0

changes.expected: A saturated amber glow with fin rhythm visible, a soft spill onto the ceiling above and the slotted face below; band becomes the warmest, most saturated feature after the speakers.

changes.problem: The frame is too dark for print; shadows have no detail.
changes.expected: Frame median about 25-30, ceiling and right wall readable, plinth not clipping.

changes.problem: The patrons are smeared into translucent grey ghosts that say 'render'.

evidence.measured: seen: figures at the counter and banquette are see-through blurs with no edges

change.to: 4 figures, shutter 0.25, seated, backs or profiles to camera, one with a glass in hand

changes.expected: Solid, softly blurred silhouettes that read as people at the counter and banquette, faces still unreadable.

changes.problem: A fifth of the frame on the right is a dead dark pier, and the lantern sits off to one side rather than ending the room.

change.to: [-3.2, 3.7, 1.5] looking at [13.0, 4.2, 1.85], 35 mm (step about 0.7 m toward the room's centreline, keep verticals true)

changes.expected: The pier drops out or narrows to a thin frame edge; the lantern sits nearer the centre as the room's vanishing point.

changes.problem: The ceiling and the island body are black voids; the downlights light nothing visible.
changes.expected: Faint cones under the downlights, a readable ceiling plane, the island's front edge separated from the floor.

changes.problem: The terrazzo plinth in the foreground is the brightest large area and pulls the eye away from the lantern.

evidence.measured: lum_median 79.8, p95 145.9, brighter than anything but the band

change.setting: the shop wall spots and the table spot
change.from: shop wall 3 x 14.0 W, table 8.0 W
change.to: shop wall 3 x 10.0 W, table 5.0 W (Core lamps' own glow left as is)

changes.expected: Plinth recedes to a mid-tone pool around each Core; the eye travels down the room to the lantern.

changes.problem: Nothing says 'through the shopfront glass': no reflection, and the mullion reads as a black bar.

evidence.measured: mullion median 9.4, no glass highlights anywhere in the dark upper corners

change.setting: the street light and glass reflection
change.from: glass reflection 0.6 with an unlit street
change.to: glass reflection 0.6 with a dim 3000 K street lamp behind camera-left and a faint passing car light, so a soft reflection lands on the dark upper-right and the mullion gets a thin edge highlight

changes.expected: A believable faint reflection in the dark areas; mullion reads as a steel frame with an edge.

changes.problem: The shop shelves read as an empty showroom fixture and the near island has no sign of life.

evidence.measured: seen: four of five shelves bare, bright strip lines; island top holds two lamps and a tray only

change.setting: small props and the shelf lines
change.to: records spine-out on two shelves, a few boxed products, shelf lines 0.6; a record out of its sleeve and a glass on the island

changes.expected: The shop reads stocked and lived-in; LED lines become a glow, not stripes.

out_of_scope.request: Calm or restrict the multicolour RGB rings of Mother EARF so she does not compete with the lantern
out_of_scope.why: EARF's products as placed are fixed; only her spot (80 W) may change. The rings are the frame's most saturated element and break the one-colour idea.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the number and spread of tinted Core lamps and coloured pendants across the shop
out_of_scope.why: The Cores and Hemispheres in tints are fixed; they scatter saturated colour across the frame.

out_of_scope.request: The Tropos pair in Ember is not legible from the street
out_of_scope.why: The pair is fixed inside the lantern; at this camera it cannot be the hero without a change to the plan.
